quests.title: Fill one column's gaps
quests.ask: Fill in `repair_column()`: from the foot of a column facing east, make it solid up to its beam, one stone per cell, then end back at its foot facing east.
quests.nudge: Some cells already hold a stone. What should the robot find out before it puts one down?

quests.title: A column of any height
quests.ask: The same `repair_column()` should work on a much shorter column too, ending at its foot facing east.
quests.nudge: Does your code know how tall a column is, or does it find out?

quests.title: Every column down the street
quests.ask: On a short street with a column at each end, repair both and finish at the east end facing east.
quests.nudge: Count the columns and the walks between them. Which one is there one more of?
